title: Command request
description: A signed COMMAND_REQUEST, sent to BALDUR-0 with POST /request (CONTRACT.md v0.6 §7.3, §8.2, §16.3). ODIN's loop fills in every field except command, parameters and rationale, which come from the model's answer. A request carries no class; BALDUR-0 looks it up (§7.4). keys/odin.pub holds ODIN's public key as one OpenSSH line, ssh-ed25519 AAAA... odin (§16.3 U13).

nonce.description: 128 random bits from the operating system's secure generator, as 32 lowercase hex characters (§16.3 U13).

plan_id.description: The plan in force when ODIN sent the request; null when none is.

agent_input_hash.description: The SHA-256 of the exact turn-bundle bytes the harness served for the turn the request answers (the Director's ruling, 26 October 2026). BALDUR-0 does not check it; the turn's TRIGGER record holds the same hash as bundle_sha256, so evaluation can match them.

signature.description: The 64-byte Ed25519 signature with ODIN's key over the canonical JSON (§4) of every other field, in standard base64 with padding: 88 characters ending in == (§16.3 U13).
